Title: Generally Available: Support for Azure Key Vault certificates in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Support for Key Vault certificates in Azure container Apps is now generally available. 

You can now use Azure Key Vault to store and manage your own TLS/SSL certificates for Azure Container Apps at the environment level. You can do so using the Azure portal as well as the Azure CLI. 

This follows security best practices by leveraging managed identities and simplifies management tasks like auto-rotation. 

Learn more.
